Hello,
This is the development team of Witch & Council: The Card.

Spring is already in the air!

notes.title: Combat Tempo & Reward System Improvement Update (Ver 2.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/e63d19e23ec88ca67408cdf9bc89a9b7fe5b16b8.png[/img]

Hello everyone!
This is the development team of <Witch and Council: The Card>.
Thank you so much for waiting so long for this update.

We are pleased to announce that the Combat Tempo Improvement Update that many of you have pointed out and suggested improvements for has finally been implemented.

Here are the main details:

[h2]1. Combat Tempo Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/255e2b7da62fdffe1677386bbdb14c48658e90b5.gif[/img]
You can now use multiple cards in succession without waiting!
Enjoy a faster-paced gameplay experience.

[h2]2. Adjustment to Combat Reward Cards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/93213a5786e6f57481e87f1f272b9bdb41f1c248.jpg[/img]
When you win a battle, the reward selection will now only include cards of the characters in your party.

[h2]3. Event Result : Text Display[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/e3fcec7b48365cd8640e4000534da5e9c36ed28c.jpg[/img]
Event outcomes can now be viewed in text form.

[h2]4. Changes to Cursed Relic Acquisition[/h2]
Cursed relics will no longer appear in treasure rooms.

[h2]5. Translations[/h2]
> Overall translation consistency has been improved.
> Fixed an issue where some text would change significantly after upgrading a card.

[h2]6. Other Changes[/h2]
> Added a transformation effect for Sibilla.
> Adjusted some aspects of the game’s balance.
> Fixed other bugs.

We sincerely apologize once again for making you wait so long for the combat tempo improvements.
We hope this update will allow everyone to enjoy the game more comfortably.

If you find any bugs or translation-related issues, please report them on our Discord or Steam Discussion channels!

Thank you.

notes.title: 1st Content Update (Ver 1.2.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/6ba8986f4108a3e8c7158cf6c67a343456f5935f.png[/img]

Hello,  
This is the development team of 《Witch & Council: The Card》.  

Thank you for patiently waiting for the update.  
The "Content Update" mentioned in our update plan has been implemented today.  
Here are the key details:  

[b]1. New Character Added: "Student Council President Sybilla"[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/04c7a09a5ae1cacd9f964ce0e8bf69ec6e51d314.png[/img]
- You can now play as "Student Council President Sybilla," who was previously the boss of the Witch's Tower!  
- Sybilla is a character who utilizes diverse strategies by switching between "Berserk Mode" and "Calm Mode."  
- Add Sybilla to your team and explore new strategies!  

[b]2. New Chapter Added: "The Broken Dimension"[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/9fac80bb7e9716a77b68d1f5822255911ac0b186.png[/img]
- The upper floors of the Witch's Tower, a previously unknown area, have been unlocked!  
- Enjoy the Witch's Tower mode continuously up to the upper floors and challenge yourself to achieve higher scores!  

[b]3. Balance Adjustments[/b]
- The balance and battle patterns of certain monsters and bosses have been adjusted.  
- Rewards for some events have been modified.  
- Cards and relics of unacquired characters are no longer obtainable.  

[b]4. Others[/b]
- 15 new monsters have been added.  
- New relics, events, and scrolls have been added.  
- A new opening video for the mode has been added.  
- Sound effects have been improved.  

[b]※ Announcement of Upcoming Updates ※[/b]

[b]1. Combat Tempo Improvements[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/255e2b7da62fdffe1677386bbdb14c48658e90b5.gif[/img]
- Significant progress has been made on combat tempo improvements.  
  We are currently working on fixing bugs, and the update is expected to be released as early as February.  
  We sincerely apologize for the long wait.  
- We will provide additional announcements as soon as the feature update is ready.  


If you encounter any bugs or translation issues, please report them on our Discord or Steam Discussion channels!  
We will actively reflect your feedback as we receive it.  

Although there is still room for improvement, we would be incredibly grateful if you could leave positive reviews to support our development efforts!  
We are doing our best to develop a game that you can truly enjoy.  

Thank you.

notes.title: 4th Hotfix Update (Ver 1.1.4)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/df6822f0c375f8d8cd1dbf15348d3502a4b66f5d.png[/img]

Hello,  
This is the development team of 《Witch and Council: The Card》.  

Today, we released the 4th hotfix update.  
Here are the key details:  

1. Balance Adjustments  
- Adjusted monster placements in Scenario Mode Chapters 2 and 3 to lower the difficulty.  
- Reduced the laser attack damage of the Chapter 2 boss in Scenario Mode.  
- Reduced the stats of Red Zombie (HP 93 → 76, Bandage trait 4 → 3).  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/2cec6b4a995dc39dcf96d1cd1da95d893c38e926.png[/img]


2. Translation Improvements (2nd)
- Improved consistency in character names in Traditional Chinese.  
- Made overall improvements to the Japanese and English translations.  

While we strive to provide high-quality translations in English and Japanese, our small team does not include fluent developers in these languages, making thorough review challenging.  
We appreciate your help in improving translation quality!  
Please share any feedback about translations on our Discord or Steam Discussion channels.  
We will actively incorporate your suggestions.  


3. Added Features
- After clearing the scenario up to Chapter 3, players can now form their party from Chapter 1 when restarting the scenario.  
- Tutorials will no longer appear when replaying the scenario after completing Chapter 3.  
- In Rest Stages, players can now enhance/remove cards for all characters they own, including those in their current party.  
- Fixed a situation where Sibylla could be targeted during phases where targeting was intended to be disabled.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/69aef7cf46233dbca138194bbc0e4b8ee47fd62b.png[/img]


4. Bug Fixes  
- Fixed an issue where the relic "Mirror of the Past" (reduces Elite monsters' HP by 20%) only worked once.  
- Fixed an issue where the shield effect from Della’s "Soul Binding" (creates shields equal to its value each turn, including bosses) would disappear immediately after being applied.  
- Fixed a bug where exclusive scrolls for unowned characters could be obtained in the Treasure Room.  
- Fixed an issue on some maps where certain stages were not properly connected.  

We are continuing to improve the game based on our previously shared development plans.  
Although there are still areas for improvement, we would greatly appreciate it if you could leave positive reviews (or update your existing ones) on Steam to encourage us further!  
We will do our best to develop a game that satisfies all of our players.  

Thank you.

notes.title: 3rd Hotfix Update (Ver 1.1.3)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/6d3dafcc1cd4aca5d68a1f0dd6885cfcff01463d.png[/img]

Hello,  
This is the development team of <Witch and Council: The Card>.

Today, the 3rd hotfix update has been applied.  
The main updates are as follows:


1. 4K Resolution Support (3840x2160)
- You can now enjoy the game in high resolution.
- Adjustments have been made to enable full-screen gameplay on monitors with aspect ratios other than 16:9.  
  (Black bars will appear to fill empty spaces depending on the screen ratio.)

2. English and Japanese Translation Improvements (1st Phase)
- We apologize to players who had difficulty enjoying the game due to the low quality of English and Chinese translations.  
  The first round of translation improvements has been applied.

- Although we aim to provide higher-quality English and Japanese translations, we are a small team without native fluency in these languages, making proper proofreading challenging.  
  To continue improving translation quality, we would greatly appreciate your assistance.  
  If you have any feedback regarding translations, please share it with us via our Discord or Steam Discussion channels!  
  We are committed to actively incorporating your suggestions.


3. Other Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the instant death option of Della's "Killing Field" card based on HP conditions was applied to elite and boss enemies.
- Fixed an issue where defeating the final enemy with the instant death option of Della's "Killing Field" card required ending the turn to trigger the victory animation.
- Adjusted the party card window to allow players to view the base stats of currently owned cards.
- Fixed an issue where the game would freeze if a target with both the "Target" debuff and "Invincible" buff was attacked by an opponent.
- Fixed an issue where the poison effect granted by the relic "Special Poison" was not counted by some of Rose's cards using poison counters.
- Fixed an issue where cards added by the relic "Card Creator" did not receive the effect of the relic "Blessing of Mana" (making the first card used cost 0).
- Fixed an issue where using a defense card (including emergency defense cards) when the relic "Ghost's Gift" had 4 counts would restore mana.
- Fixed an issue where the effect of the relic "Wizard's Shield" (gain 1 shield each time a card is used) did not activate when using buff-type cards.
- Fixed an issue where attempting to add cards with a card addition scroll when the hand was full (10 cards) caused all cards in the hand to disappear.
- Fixed an issue where fonts were not displayed correctly in some parts of the UI when changing the language.


We are continuously improving the game based on the development plans we previously shared.  
While there are still areas for improvement, your positive updates to Steam reviews (or new reviews) would be greatly appreciated and would motivate us even more!  

We are committed to developing a game that satisfies our players to the fullest.

Thank you!

notes.title: 2nd Hotfix Update (Ver 1.1.2)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/15d733dd5a960b4f0305b079743b793a6dc0b353.png[/img]

Hello,
This is the development team of <Witch and Council: The Card>

Today, we have implemented the 2nd hotfix update.
The main details are as follows:

1. Chinese Translation Improvements (1st)
First, we sincerely apologize to players who had difficulty enjoying the game due to the low quality of the Chinese translations.
We have updated the first phase of translation improvements.

While we wish to provide higher-quality Chinese translations, we are a small team and do not have a developer proficient in Chinese, which makes review challenging.

We would greatly appreciate your support in helping us continue to improve the translation quality.
If you have any feedback regarding translations, please share it with us on Discord or the Steam Discussion channel!

We will actively incorporate your suggestions.


2. Crash Bug Fixes
We have resolved issues causing the game to freeze during gameplay.


3. Miscellaneous
To prevent reward information pop-ups from being obscured by characters on the result screen, we have adjusted the pop-up display position.
Fixed an issue where the speech bubble dialogue for characters on the victory result screen was not translated.
Fixed an issue where leaderboard rankings were not displayed correctly.


4. Additional English and Japanese Translation Updates (Planned)
Additional translation updates for English and Japanese are scheduled for release this week.
We are currently working to improve the game according to the development plan we previously shared.

While there are still many areas for improvement, we would be truly grateful if you could leave positive Steam reviews (or update your existing reviews) to encourage us!

We will do our best to develop a game that satisfies all players.

Thank you.

notes.title: Future Update Plan
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620035/eba2051d220c6f4feb441c1d2371375343e6928d.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!
This is the development team for Witch and the Student Council: The Card.

We’re excited to share our future update plan, which is scheduled for January 2025.

a. New Playable Character: Student Council President Sibylla
●	You’ll be able to include Student Council President Sibylla in your party and enjoy the game with her.

b. New Chapter: Upper Floors of the Witch’s Tower Mode
●	The upper floors of the Witch’s Tower Mode will be added, featuring stronger monsters, new relics, and events.

Additionally, bug fixes and balance adjustments will be implemented (with hotfix patches made as necessary before the main update).

We are also working on developing a Quick Card Play feature and joystick support (which may be released before or after the first content update, depending on the development schedule).

Please share your feedback and bug reports on Discord. We’re committed to incorporating your suggestions into our development process.

We’ll do our best to make the game more enjoyable and exciting.

Thank you!
